Callout.Name: Stolen Emergency Vehicle
Callout.Message: Ambulance stolen from outside a hospital.
Callout.Advisory: Vehicle heading north, driver in a uniform.

Script.Line: It was taken from outside the department with the keys left in it.
It has a full tank and a radio. That is the problem.
Whoever has it can hear everything we say.

Lines.Approach: Somebody has taken an ambulance from the hospital bay. Blue lights, no crew.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
